protocol.ranking: No winner is fitted or tuned on evaluation. Report paired effects per condition and Pareto tradeoffs; describe as best among tested conditions only.
protocol.failures: Retain status=error, deadline misses and rejected cargo. Cancelled/incomplete attempts are preserved separately and may be resumed; no success-only primary filtering.
protocol.time: Canonical worker-thread supervisor per Node process; identical 9000ms search window and 10000ms full cycle. Native candidate/iteration caps differ and are disclosed.
protocol.timing: Parallel shared-machine throughput and observed wall-deadline behavior under contention. Not isolated latency. Compare latency with separately saved serial pilot.
protocol.scheduling: Condition by seed-index batch. Algorithms interleaved and rotated within each seed; no adaptive allocation from observed quality. Concurrency and batch size frozen.
protocol.sampling: Fixed synthetic inventory; unique arrival seeds AND unique SKU sequences within condition. Differences concern arrival orders, not 1000 different geometries.
protocol.conditions: Two fixed 30-box SKU mixes (6 and 8 SKU), both at 1200mm. SKU mix changes supplied volume; compare supply acceptance within condition.
protocol.statistics: Paired seed differences, ordinary 95% t intervals plus Bonferroni simultaneous intervals for the 12 primary comparisons; no universal optimum claim.
